meta.tagline: Compare how outlets across the spectrum cover the same story
meta.description: News grouped by story, with coverage split by left, center and right outlets, in English and Khmer.

blindspot.title: Blindspot
blindspot.subtitle: Stories covered heavily by one side of the political spectrum and barely, or not at all, by the other.
blindspot.leftDesc: Stories that had little or no reporting from left-leaning outlets.
blindspot.rightDesc: Stories that had little or no reporting from right-leaning outlets.
blindspot.empty: No blindspots in the current feed. Check back after the next refresh.
blindspot.about: A story is a blindspot when at least three rated outlets covered it and one side has none of them while the other has most. Center outlets count toward the total but not toward either side.

home.demoBanner: Demo mode: these are sample articles, not live news.

story.noRight: No right-leaning outlets in our list covered this story.

local.title: Local
local.subtitle: Top stories for {location}
local.chooseText: See the top stories about a country, including reports from outlets based there.
local.detected: Detected automatically. You can change it anytime.
local.emptyText: No story in the current feed was filed by an outlet based there or is mostly about it. The feed refreshes every 30 minutes.
local.khmerCoverageText: Recent reports from Khmer-language outlets. They are listed on their own because stories are grouped from English-language coverage only.
local.khmerEmpty: No Khmer-language reports in the last two days.
local.noOutlets: We do not follow any outlets based in {location} yet, so local stories come from international coverage.
local.latestFromOutletsText: Reports from outlets based there that no other outlet in our list has covered yet, so they are not grouped into stories.

forYou.subtitle: Stories from the topics and outlets you follow.

sources.title: Sources and bias ratings
sources.intro: Each outlet has one rating, approximated from public media-bias charts such as AllSides and Ad Fontes Media. A story's coverage bar counts how many outlets from each side reported it, so several feeds from one outlet count once.
sources.unratedIntro: Outlets those charts do not cover are shown as "Not rated". They appear in stories and on the Local page but are left out of the left, center and right percentages.

search.title: Search
search.hint: Search headlines, summaries and outlet names in English or Khmer.
search.none: No results for “{query}”. Try a different keyword or an outlet name.

account.title: Accounts are coming soon
account.text: For now the topics you follow, your language and your location are saved on this device. Sign in and synced follows are the next step.

footer.tagline: Compare how outlets across the spectrum cover the same story, in English and Khmer.
footer.ratingsNote: Bias ratings are approximate and based on public charts. Cambodian outlets are not rated.
footer.howItWorksText: Articles from {outlets} outlets are grouped by story every 30 minutes. Summaries are AI-generated from those articles and are not independently fact-checked. Always read the original reporting.
